facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya directed commercial banks by letter of 4 March 2026 to activate the LYPay instant payment system in their banking apps for QR-code purchases at POS devices by 8 March.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya letter of 4 March 2026 requires banks to activate the LYPay instant payment system within banking apps so customers can pay at POS by scanning a QR code, and calls for a joint bank campaign to promote it.

systems.platform: instant payment system in banking apps

facts.fact: A decree by Prime Minister Aldabaiba made e-payment an approved method for collecting state revenues and public dues, requiring Ministry of Finance treasuries and other ministries, departments and agencies to accept it alongside cash and cheques.
